verdict.rationale: Docs claim Devin autonomously writes, runs, and tests code to implement full features and tickets end-to-end (devin-docs-1, devin-docs-18), but independent evidence shows a benchmark resolving only 13.8% of issues and reviewers noting demos were narrow/impressive-but-limited and didn't match real job requirements (devin-comm-1, devin-comm-2, devin-comm-3), casting doubt on reliable end-to-end autonomous delivery. missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of full feature+test delivery success rate, resolution of the contradicting benchmark data.
